message: grounding is made required in answers.v1 in place: every stored answers.v1 artifact no longer validates. A breaking change needs a new version (answers.v2, SCHEMA_VERSIONS, SUPERSEDED_VERSIONS) or an optional field; schema_compat fails on it.
Adds dokimi.eval.grounding to the [[tool.mypy.overrides]] ignore_errors list, which only shrinks. It hides real errors in annotate_answers (score: float = None); annotate them float | None instead.
annotate_answers renames the persisted with_docs / without_docs keys to with_context / baseline in an answers.v1 artifact; eval score, reports and _contexts_of read with_docs and find no answers.
Off-by-one: len(contexts) > min_contexts should be >=, as in evaluate_grounding. With the default 1, an answer with exactly one snippet gets null scores.
The docs use --min-docs, but the flag is --min-contexts: the documented command fails with unrecognized arguments and test_docs_code_refs fails.
annotate_answers rebuilds each item from a fixed set of fields and drops the rest of the input record.
The grounding report summary does not record which min_contexts filter was applied.
